negatives.failure_signature: The read-only combined probe exceeded a ten-second PowerShell budget and returned no evidence.
negatives.trigger_precondition: Cold shell startup combined parent traversal with an unrelated drive query.
negatives.recovery: Retained the timeout and split direct literal-path instruction checks from the capacity query under a thirty-second bound.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Use literal paths and wider bounded startup budgets for environment probes.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; the timed-out command supplied no instruction or capacity evidence

negatives.failure_signature: The runner rejected an unsupported --input flag before ledger mutation.
negatives.trigger_precondition: A flag name was inferred instead of copied from the exact runner interface.
negatives.recovery: Retained the parser failure and used --record-file for both prepared records.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; argument parsing stopped before the ledger changed

negatives.failure_signature: A passing witness auto-promoted the method, so an explicit validated-to-validated transition was rejected.
negatives.trigger_precondition: The witness append was treated as evidence-only rather than a possible state transition.
negatives.recovery: Retained the invalid transition and allowed subsequent passing witnesses to promote without duplicate set-state calls.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Inspect witness results before any explicit promotion.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; the redundant transition did not change the already validated state

negatives.failure_signature: The summarize subcommand rejected an inferred --out flag after earlier append operations succeeded.
negatives.trigger_precondition: A file-output flag was copied from another tool rather than the current subcommand.
negatives.recovery: Retained the failure, read summarize help, and used --json-output and --markdown-output.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Preflight each Method Flow subcommand separately.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; no summary file was produced by the rejected invocation

negatives.failure_signature: The loader found 320 records, then cp1252 stdout failed on a Maori macron.
negatives.trigger_precondition: Unicode family text was printed through the default Windows console encoding.
negatives.recovery: Retained the encoding fault and reran read-only with PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Pin UTF-8 for family ledgers and cultural-language text.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; the truncated display was not credited as a complete audit

negatives.failure_signature: A four-command parallel source inspection exceeded thirty seconds after only one slice returned.
negatives.trigger_precondition: Large generated sources were read concurrently on cold PowerShell processes.
negatives.recovery: Retained the partial timeout and read the required evidence-builder slices serially with sixty-second bounds.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Serialize large generated-source reads and credit only zero-exit slices.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; partial aggregate output was not a full review witness

negatives.failure_signature: The new builder import stopped because its phase-specific definitions module did not yet exist.
negatives.trigger_precondition: A mechanically scaffolded phase tool was imported before its dependency was created.
negatives.recovery: Retained the dependency-order failure and used the complete predecessor collector for the read-only source audit.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Preflight phase-local module dependencies before import.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; no source rows were read by the failed import

negatives.failure_signature: Git staged the packet but warned that twenty-one LF working-copy files may be replaced by CRLF on a later touch.
negatives.trigger_precondition: Windows line-ending conversion policy applied to new UTF-8 text artifacts.
negatives.recovery: Retained the warnings, bound the content seal to staged Git blobs, and reserved working-tree portability for the one final clean named replay.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Separate staged-index bytes from working-tree bytes and do not change host Git configuration.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; staging success alone does not establish checkout portability

negatives.failure_signature: The review found seventeen content-seal mismatches and diff-check failures after a command-local line-ending filter override staged CRLF bytes.
negatives.trigger_precondition: Repository-normalized content-seal semantics were combined with core.autocrlf=false during restaging.
negatives.recovery: Retained the failed review, restored repository-default staging filters for the same owned files, and required direct LF blob and seal parity before review credit.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Never override repository clean filters when the content seal targets filtered Git blobs.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; the failed review supplied no x1 freeze credit

negatives.failure_signature: The index still contained twenty-four CRLF blobs after default restaging, so staged newline parity remained false.
negatives.trigger_precondition: Platform-default generator writes produced CRLF and repository filters did not normalize every owner path.
negatives.recovery: Retained the parity failure and changed only the owner generator to emit LF explicitly before regeneration and restaging.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Pin LF at generation time and verify index bytes directly instead of relying on host filters.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; the mixed-newline index received no x1 freeze credit

retention_rule: Recovery does not erase failure evidence; only successful corrected runs may be promoted.
